evidence.finding: Canonical proposals, decisions/reject codes, fill history, forward outcome evidence, liabilities/positions, and economic components have owners. No accepted artifact provides one immutable, forward-only reference contract joining proposal, fill, cost, liability, evidence, and Q lineage without copying owner truth. That cross-owner reference contract is a real F8 delta; source production and persistence are not.

Capital already owns exact-decimal gross, basis/directional, realized/unrealized, fee, spread/slippage, funding, borrow, execution-shortfall, one-leg, recovery, FX, and unresolved-residual composition, with missing/estimated/divergent states. F8 must consume EconomicReport/components by immutable reference and must not create another PnL taxonomy, net calculator, or accounting authority.

Walk-forward partitions, embargo/purge/holdout rules, point-in-time identity, calibration, abstention, conformal/uncertainty evidence, trial accounting, PBO/BH, and DSR already belong to Q. F8 may store exact refs and project their values; it may not split data, recalibrate, choose trials, recompute selection controls, or collapse distinct Q counts into a fabricated selection-pressure scalar. Q is frozen and not moving, but its source is not an ancestor of accepted Main f0168cb.

Capital partially represents signal through gross/basis/directional measures and already represents execution, fees, slippage, funding, borrow, recovery, and residual. It has no explicit timing/latency component and no reject-economic component. No accepted report binds those owned measures to forward-only Q/MI outcomes to separate signal from timing and to show reject effects. This measurement-only binding is missing.

Capital dimensions cover strategy, opportunity, config revision, stage, symbol, leg, and correlation. Strategy and symbol are therefore already owned. Venue, regime, attributed turnover, capacity, and latency are absent; capacity elsewhere is pretrade or operational state, not an economic breakdown. F8 may add only read-only breakdown keys backed by owner-supplied refs, with missing keys remaining unavailable.

Capital already has exact estimated ranges and Q owns uncertainty, multiplicity, and deflated-performance evidence. No accepted Edge/PnL report projects an attribution interval beside exact Q trial/PBO/DSR refs and an explicit unresolved residual. F8's delta is the deterministic projection, never recomputation.

ABSTAIN_UNKNOWN exists at the protocol/Q boundary and Q has typed data-insufficiency evidence, while Capital has MISSING/UNKNOWN/PARTIAL/DIVERGENT. There is no canonical EdgeMeter report contract that emits explicit INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, ABSTAIN_UNKNOWN, and NON_COMPARABLE outcomes. The protocol's optional pnlAttribution is an unshaped nullable object and has no accepted producer or consumer.

systemIntegration exposes no economic/edge report in its supervisor summaries or routes, Capital's adapters are documented dormant, and the accepted cockpit mounts five surfaces without a PnL attribution projection. F8 may produce deterministic fixture reports and a future cockpit insertion request only; it may not mount a page, add routes, or claim runtime truth.

REAL, HYPOTHETICAL, and REPLAY evidence classes must remain distinct. Historical fit cannot become live evidence; hypothetical PnL cannot become realized PnL. No F8 output may mutate Capital, Risk, Q promotion, L execution, canonical state, or product composition, and no report may declare edge or profitability.

Legacy /api/pnl is float/average-cost Spot fill accounting summarized by day/symbol/fees. Its UI uses placeholders for funding/borrow and is not mounted as the pnl page. It is neither forward-only nor Q-referenced and does not close the F8 gap. It also must not be promoted into a competing canonical owner.

Q at 02b4ecc and L at df6b472 are frozen; accepted Capital, Foundation calibration, and MI outcome owner blobs are stable. The active moving owner is I00 composition/cockpit repair, but §9B grants F8 no mounting authority and requires only a future projection request. Accepted Main also lacks the complete private fact adapters present in the unwired L donor; F8 must represent those inputs as unavailable and cannot import or race them. I00 movement blocks product insertion, not this fixture-only real-delta finding. F0 must separately record both required facets USABLE before the director may release an implementation worktree.

Approve only a removable, deterministic, fixture-mode, measurement-only reference/report adapter: bind canonical owner artifacts immutably; project signal-versus-timing and reject effects where owner evidence permits; add the missing comparative breakdown/output-state contract; carry Capital/Q uncertainty and selection-control refs without recomputation; and emit a future cockpit request.
